published_source: Article (Management Science 72(4), 2026) Table 11 Panel B, column (2), EVerify_All: 0.056 with z = 3.34, Observations 734,068; published_se = coef/z. Also in the authors' shipped output data/t11b.csv. Authors' call (2. stata code.do lines 345-358: csdid y1, ivar(id) time(cyear) gvar(event); estat simple; y1 = ln(1 + tri_all)) re-run in Stata 16.1 with csdid 1.81 on data/csdid_all.dta: ATT 0.0556379 (SE 0.0166532, z 3.34), N 734,068, 'Will use observations with Pair balanced'. Log: scratchpad/stata/t02310.log.
replication_status: exact (Stata csdid on the shipped file reproduces the printed coefficient and N; R hand implementation of csdid's pair-balanced cells with never-treated controls and cell-count weights gives 0.0556379, scratchpad/meta4/csdid_hand_02310.R)
notes: Reported modern estimator: csdid y1, ivar(id) time(cyear) gvar(event) followed by estat simple (2. stata code.do lines 345-358), csdid defaults (never-treated controls, doubly-robust IPW without covariates = simple 2x2 DiD of means, unit-level clustering). Sample: universal-mandate states and never-treated states only (public-mandate states deleted; public-mandate years of GA/NC/SC/UT deleted); cohorts 2007 (AZ), 2008 (MS), 2010 (UT), 2011 (GA, NC, SC, AL, LA, TN); because the deleted public-mandate years include g-1 for GA/NC/SC/UT, those units have no base-period observation and drop out of the CSA cells (TWFE keeps them). Shipped file has only id, cyear, event, tri_all (no state variable), so clustering follows the authors' csdid (unit level); the published_coef is the authors' CSA estimate, the pipeline TWFE is the plain unit + year FE regression on the same sample (no chemical-by-year FE, as in csdid). gvar = passage year; passage-year rows are deleted so 1{cyear >= event} switches on the year after passage, the same timing as the paper's TWFE indicator; CSA base period = passage year - 1. AUTHORS' CSA SETTINGS (PROTOCOL 5b Hull alignment (c)): csdid defaults, i.e. NEVER-treated controls (csa_control_group = 'nevertreated'; with notyet the same call gives 0.054789), no covariates, simple aggregation, and pair-balanced cells on the unbalanced panel (units observed in both g-1 and t; the simple ATT weights each post cell by the number of cohort-g units in that cell), hence csa_cells = 'pairs'. csdid's SE is clustered at the unit (id) level, whereas the table note says state; the printed z matches the unit-clustered analytic SE.
